title: `self-assigning-variable` - option to allow reassignment with type annotation
author: DetachHead
body_preview: ### Summary  some codebases allow reassignment to a variable if it has a type annotation ie. shadowing:  ```py foo = 1  def fn(foo: int):     ...     foo: int | str = foo # error: self-assigning-variable ``` it would be nice if ruff had an option to allow this, especially since it's supported by most type checkers including ty. (in pyright it's configurable using `reportRedeclaration`)

title: Nested .gitignore negations can never re-include what an ancestor excluded
author: KaizenShogun
body_preview: **Describe the bug**  A negation in a nested `.gitignore` can never re-include something an ancestor `.gitignore` excluded. Git decides the other way round: the *deepest* gitignore file that has a matching pattern wins, and only inside that file does last-match-win. Black ORs across gitignore files, so the deepest one — the only one that can say `!` — is often never consulted.  Effect: `black .` s...
